Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching wedding planning companies in Bangladesh, and Metro Weddings came up as a premium player. The wedding industry in Dhaka is booming, but the enquiry-to-booking conversion is brutal — couples message 5-10 wedding planners on Instagram, and the one who replies fastest with the most relevant package wins.

Here's what I see: booking is WhatsApp-only (+880****4358), and every enquiry requires manual back-and-forth about dates, guest count, venue preference, and budget. During peak wedding season (Nov-Feb), your team is drowning in enquiries, and leads go cold when replies take more than 2-3 hours.

I built an AI wedding consultant agent that handles Instagram/WhatsApp enquiries 24/7 — it asks about wedding date, guest count, venue preference, and budget range, then provides instant package recommendations and books a consultation with your planning team. It also sends automated follow-ups to couples who enquired but didn't book.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
